summary: BiKonya-style redesign validated end-to-end. Backend: 26/26 pytest tests PASS — new endpoints /api/namaz (6 prayer times, next_index/next_name/next_time/next_in shape), /api/indirimler (6 mock campaigns with image_url/discount_pct/valid_until), /api/categories enriched with group/subtitle/icon/bg/color/count/image_url including all new slugs (yeme-icme, ikinci-el, piknik, noter, kayip-buluntu, namaz, alo-paket, konaklama, gezilecek, resmi-kurumlar, itiraflar, anketler), /api/posts?sort=trend (desc by like_count) and ?sort=latest (desc by created_at). All previous endpoints still return 200. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Home renders BiKonya layout perfectly — header logo+Seydişehir+search/notif, search bar 'Bu hafta etkinlik var mı?', 3 top cards (Nöbetçi Eczane/Ulaşım/Alo Taksi) with colored accents, Hizmetler dark grid (Haberler/Etkinlikler/Yeme&İçme/Emlak&Araç/İkinci El/İndirimler) with count badges + light icon grid (Gezilecek/Piknik/Konaklama/İş İlanları/Hizmet Verenler/Nöbetçi Noter), green Namaz card with 6 pills, Fırsatlar + Son İlanlar sections. Kategoriler tab matches reference with 6 group headers + subtitles + grouped white cards with chevrons (18 categories visible). Buradayım: pink #E03864 header, '+ Paylaş' button, Trend/Son Paylaşılanlar pill tabs both functional (posts re-fetched on tab change), 9 posts with avatar/@username/Seydişehir pin/date/text/image/like-toggle (verified heart fill)/comment/flag/Yorumlar link. Namaz screen: green hero with city/date/next prayer/countdown pill + full 6-prayer list with İmsak highlighted. Center FAB navigates to /yeni-gonderi correctly. Console: only deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents) — no errors, no red screens.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated `pointerEvents` prop on View (line 64). React Native deprecated this; use `style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }}` instead. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:64
`shadow*` style props are deprecated on web. Should use `boxShadow` or platform-specific style. Console warning emitted repeatedly. Reference: /app/frontend/constants/theme.ts (shadow object)

tabBarTestID on Tabs.Screen options does not render as data-testid on Expo web build, so non-FAB tab buttons (tab-home, tab-categories, tab-buradayim, tab-profile) are not selectable by automated tests. Visually present and functional. Consider using tabBarButton with a custom Pressable carrying testID for each tab to enable e2e tab-tap testing.

action_items: Optional: replace `pointerEvents` prop with style.pointerEvents in (tabs)/_layout.tsx to silence RN warning.
Optional: migrate `shadow*` styles in constants/theme.ts to `boxShadow` for web compatibility.
Optional: expose data-testid on non-FAB tab buttons via tabBarButton render to enable e2e tab navigation testing on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event hooks; recommend migration to lifespan context.
Mock auth token is plain user_id — fine for MVP but should be JWT for production.
Categories list (21 items) is hard-coded in server.py; consider moving to seed collection if it grows further.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 indirim records on startup (seed_indirimler). All other seed unchanged.
